name: What server do Australian pilots connect to?

-- Query to identify Australian pilots and their server connections
-- Australian pilots have 'Y' as the 4th last character in their name field

SELECT 
    f.server,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.cid) as australian_pilot_count
FROM flights f
WHERE 
    -- Check if the 4th last character of the name field is 'Y'
    SUBSTRING(f.name, LENGTH(f.name) - 3, 1) = 'Y'
    -- Ensure name is not null and has at least 4 characters
    AND f.name IS NOT NULL 
    AND LENGTH(f.name) >= 4
    -- Only include recent/active flights from last 24 hours
    AND f.last_updated >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
GROUP BY f.server
ORDER BY australian_pilot_count DESC, f.server;

name: What percentage of flights had at least one ATC interaction?
sql:
-- Percentage of flights with any ATC interaction (rolling, UTC windows)
WITH canonical AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (callsign, cid, departure, arrival, logon_time)
         id, callsign, cid, departure, arrival, logon_time,
         controller_time_percentage, completion_time
  FROM flight_summaries
  WHERE completion_time IS NOT NULL
    AND controller_time_percentage IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY callsign, cid, departure, arrival, logon_time, completion_time DESC, id DESC
),
periods AS (
  SELECT 'yesterday' AS period_name,
         COUNT(*) AS total_flights,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE controller_time_percentage > 0) AS flights_with_atc
  FROM canonical
  WHERE (completion_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '1 day'
    AND (completion_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') <  date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'last_7_days',
         COUNT(*),
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE controller_time_percentage > 0)
  FROM canonical
  WHERE (completion_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '7 days'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'last_30_days',
         COUNT(*),
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE controller_time_percentage > 0)
  FROM canonical
  WHERE (completion_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '30 days'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'last_90_days',
         COUNT(*),
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE controller_time_percentage > 0)
  FROM canonical
  WHERE (completion_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '90 days'
)
SELECT period_name,
       total_flights,
       flights_with_atc,
       CASE WHEN total_flights > 0
            THEN ROUND((flights_with_atc::numeric / total_flights * 100))
            ELSE 0 END AS percentage_with_atc
FROM periods
ORDER BY CASE period_name
           WHEN 'yesterday'   THEN 1
           WHEN 'last_7_days' THEN 2
           WHEN 'last_30_days' THEN 3
           WHEN 'last_90_days' THEN 4
         END;

  FROM flight_summaries

  AND completion_time <  date_trunc('day', now())

    AND completion_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month'

-- Simple Query: Top 10 Most Popular VFR Routes in Past Month
-- 
-- This query finds the 10 most popular VFR routes by unique pilots
-- who have flown between departure and arrival airports in the last 30 days.
-- Only includes routes with 3 or more unique VFR aircraft.
--
-- Usage:
--   docker exec vatsim_postgres psql -U vatsim_user -d vatsim_data -f scripts/simple_popular_vfr_routes.sql
--

SELECT 
    CONCAT(departure, ' → ', arrival) as route,
    COUNT(DISTINCT callsign) as unique_pilots,
    COUNT(*) as total_vfr_flights,
    ROUND(AVG(time_online_minutes), 1) as avg_flight_duration_minutes,
    ROUND(AVG(controller_time_percentage), 1) as avg_atc_contact_percentage,
    MIN(completion_time) as first_flight_date,
    MAX(completion_time) as last_flight_date
FROM flight_summaries 
WHERE flight_rules = 'V'  -- VFR flights only
    AND departure IS NOT NULL 
    AND arrival IS NOT NULL
    AND departure != ''
    AND arrival != ''
    AND departure != arrival  -- Exclude flights that don't actually go anywhere
    AND completion_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'  -- Last 30 days only
GROUP BY departure, arrival
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT callsign) >= 3  -- Only show routes with at least 3 unique pilots
ORDER BY unique_pilots DESC, total_vfr_flights DESC
LIMIT 10;

-- Find Aircraft with Highest Sustained Groundspeed (High Performance Version)
-- 
-- This query finds the highest peak groundspeeds for aircraft with valid destinations.
-- Each aircraft (callsign) appears only once with their highest performance.
-- Excludes supersonic jets, military aircraft, business jets, and turboprops.
--
-- Usage:
--   docker exec vatsim_postgres psql -U vatsim_user -d vatsim_data -f scripts/highest_sustained_groundspeed.sql
--

-- Find top peak groundspeeds in the past week (unique by callsign)
WITH top_peak_speeds AS (
    SELECT 
        callsign,
        aircraft_type,
        departure,
        arrival,
        groundspeed as peak_speed_knots,
        altitude as altitude_feet,
        latitude,
        longitude,
        last_updated as peak_time,
        name as pilot_name
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            callsign,
            aircraft_type,
            departure,
            arrival,
            groundspeed,
            altitude,
            latitude,
            longitude,
            last_updated,
            name,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY callsign ORDER BY groundspeed DESC) as rn
        FROM flights 
        WHERE groundspeed IS NOT NULL 
            AND groundspeed > 100  -- Higher threshold for better performance
            AND groundspeed <= 750  -- Filter out unrealistic speeds
            AND altitude > 1000  -- Must be airborne
            AND last_updated >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 week'  -- Last month only
            AND arrival IS NOT NULL  -- Must have destination
            AND arrival != ''  -- Destination cannot be empty
            -- Exclude supersonic jets and military aircraft
            AND aircraft_type NOT IN (
                'CONC', 'TU144', 'TU160', 'MIG21', 'MIG23', 'MIG25', 'MIG29', 'MIG31',
                'SU27', 'SU30', 'SU33', 'SU35', 'SU57', 'F14', 'F15', 'F16', 'F18', 'FA18',
                'F22', 'F35', 'TYPH', 'RAF', 'GRIP', 'MIR2', 'MIR4', 'HAR', 'JAG', 'VF35',
                'TORN', 'VIGG', 'M2K', 'RAPH', 'EF2K', 'GR4', 'FGR4', 'F4', 'F5', 'HAWK',
                'A4', 'A6', 'A7', 'F111', 'F117', 'B1', 'B2', 'SR71', 'U2', 'TR1','F18S'
            )
            -- Exclude business jets
            AND aircraft_type NOT IN (
                'C550', 'C560', 'C680', 'C750', 'C850',  -- Citation series
                'BE20', 'BE30', 'BE40', 'BE90', 'BE99',  -- Beechcraft
                'GLF4', 'GLF5', 'GLF6', 'GLF7',          -- Gulfstream
                'FAL7', 'FAL8', 'FAL9', 'FAL0',          -- Falcon series
                'LJ35', 'LJ45', 'LJ60', 'LJ75',          -- Learjet series
                'CL30', 'CL60', 'CL65', 'CL85',          -- Challenger series
                'GL5T', 'GL6T', 'GL7T', 'GL8T',          -- Global series
                'E135', 'E145', 'E170', 'E175', 'E190', 'E195'  -- Embraer business jets
            )
            -- Exclude turboprops
            AND aircraft_type NOT IN (
                'AT72', 'AT76', 'AT42', 'AT45',          -- ATR series
                'DH8A', 'DH8B', 'DH8C', 'DH8D', 'DH8Q', -- Dash 8 series
                'B350', 'B190', 'B200', 'B300', 'B360', -- Beechcraft King Air
                'PC12', 'PC21', 'PC24',                  -- Pilatus series
                'AN24', 'AN26', 'AN32', 'AN72', 'AN74', -- Antonov series
                'SF34', 'SF50',                          -- Saab series
                'DHC6', 'DHC7', 'DHC8', 'K350',                 -- De Havilland Canada
                'EMB1', 'EMB2', 'EMB3', 'EMB4', 'EMB5'  -- Embraer turboprops
            )
            -- Also exclude aircraft types that start with common military prefixes
            AND aircraft_type NOT LIKE 'F-%'
            AND aircraft_type NOT LIKE 'MIG%'
            AND aircraft_type NOT LIKE 'SU-%'
            AND aircraft_type NOT LIKE 'TU-%'
            AND aircraft_type NOT LIKE 'MIR%'
    ) ranked_flights
    WHERE rn = 1  -- Only the highest speed for each callsign
    ORDER BY peak_speed_knots DESC
    LIMIT 20
)
SELECT 
    callsign,
    pilot_name,
    aircraft_type,
    departure,
    arrival,
    peak_speed_knots,
    altitude_feet,
    peak_time
FROM top_peak_speeds
ORDER BY peak_speed_knots DESC;

name: What was the fastest Milk Run Monday time (YSSY-YMML)?
sql:
WITH syd_mel AS (
  SELECT
    fs.id,
    fs.callsign,
    fs.name,
    fs.aircraft_type,
    fs.logon_time,
    fs.completion_time,
    (
      SELECT MIN(fo.entry_timestamp)
      FROM flight_sector_occupancy fo
      WHERE fo.callsign = fs.callsign
        AND fo.sector_name = 'SYA'
        AND fo.entry_timestamp BETWEEN fs.logon_time AND fs.completion_time
    ) AS sya_entry_time,
    (
      SELECT MAX(fo.exit_timestamp)
      FROM flight_sector_occupancy fo
      WHERE fo.callsign = fs.callsign
        AND fo.sector_name = 'MLA'
        AND fo.exit_timestamp BETWEEN fs.logon_time AND fs.completion_time
    ) AS mla_exit_time
  FROM flight_summaries fs
  WHERE fs.departure = 'YSSY'
    AND fs.arrival = 'YMML'
    AND EXTRACT(DOW FROM fs.completion_time) = 1
    AND fs.completion_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '6 months'
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (mla_exit_time - sya_entry_time)) / 60.0 AS sya_mla_minutes
  FROM syd_mel
  WHERE sya_entry_time IS NOT NULL
    AND mla_exit_time IS NOT NULL
    AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM sya_entry_time) >= 9  -- SYA entry after 0900 UTC
    AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM mla_exit_time) < 12   -- MLA exit before 1200 UTC
)
SELECT
  id,
  callsign,
  name,
  aircraft_type,
  logon_time,
  completion_time,
  sya_entry_time,
  mla_exit_time,
  ROUND(sya_mla_minutes, 1) AS sya_mla_minutes
FROM filtered
WHERE sya_mla_minutes >= 0
ORDER BY sya_mla_minutes ASC
LIMIT 10;

name: How many CTR/FSS controllers were active in the last 30 days?
sql:
WITH weekly_periods AS (
  SELECT 
    date_trunc('week', generate_series(
      (SELECT MIN(session_start_time) FROM controller_summaries),
      (SELECT MAX(session_start_time) FROM controller_summaries),
      '1 week'::interval
    )) AS week_start,
    date_trunc('week', generate_series(
      (SELECT MIN(session_start_time) FROM controller_summaries),
      (SELECT MAX(session_start_time) FROM controller_summaries),
      '1 week'::interval
    )) + '1 week'::interval AS week_end
),
weekly_controller_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    wp.week_start,
    wp.week_end,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cid) AS distinct_controllers_30day
  FROM weekly_periods wp
  LEFT JOIN controller_summaries cs ON cs.session_start_time >= (wp.week_end - '30 days'::interval) 
                                    AND cs.session_start_time < wp.week_end
  WHERE cs.session_duration_minutes > 60
    AND (cs.callsign LIKE '%CTR' OR cs.callsign LIKE '%FSS')
  GROUP BY wp.week_start, wp.week_end
  ORDER BY wp.week_start
)
SELECT 
  week_start AS date,
  distinct_controllers_30day AS controllers
FROM weekly_controller_counts
WHERE distinct_controllers_30day > 0
ORDER BY week_start;

name: Who's online?
sql:
-- Query to show unique callsigns currently online with latest sector

SELECT DISTINCT ON (f.callsign)
    f.callsign as flight,
    f.name,
    f.departure,
    f.arrival,
    f.aircraft_type as acft,
    fso.sector_name as latest_sector,
    fso.entry_timestamp as sector_entry_time
FROM flights f
LEFT JOIN flight_sector_occupancy fso ON (
    f.callsign = fso.callsign 
    AND fso.entry_timestamp = (
        SELECT MAX(entry_timestamp) 
        FROM flight_sector_occupancy fso2 
        WHERE fso2.callsign = f.callsign
    )
)
WHERE f.last_updated >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes'  -- Active in last 30 minutes
  AND f.cid IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY f.callsign, fso.entry_timestamp DESC;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUBSTRING(name, LENGTH(name) - 3, 1) = 'Y' THEN 'Australia'
        WHEN SUBSTRING(name, LENGTH(name) - 3, 1) = 'Z' THEN 'China'
        WHEN SUBSTRING(name, LENGTH(name) - 3, 1) IN ('V', 'W') THEN 'South and South East Asia'
        WHEN SUBSTRING(name, LENGTH(name) - 3, 1) = 'R' THEN 'East Asia'
        WHEN SUBSTRING(name, LENGTH(name) - 3, 1) IN ('N', 'A') THEN 'New Zealand and Oceania'
        WHEN SUBSTRING(name, LENGTH(name) - 3, 1) IN ('E', 'L') THEN 'Europe'
        WHEN SUBSTRING(name, LENGTH(name) - 3, 1) = 'K' THEN 'USA'
        WHEN SUBSTRING(name, LENGTH(name) - 3, 1) = 'O' THEN 'Middle East'
        WHEN SUBSTRING(name, LENGTH(name) - 3, 1) = 'C' THEN 'Canada'
        WHEN SUBSTRING(name, LENGTH(name) - 3, 1) = 'F' THEN 'Africa'
        WHEN SUBSTRING(name, LENGTH(name) - 3, 1) = 'S' THEN 'Sth America'
		ELSE 'Other/Unknown'
    END as region,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cid) as pilot_count
FROM flights 
WHERE last_updated >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
    AND name IS NOT NULL 
    AND name ~ '[A-Z]{4}$'
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY pilot_count DESC;

-- Find Military Aircraft with Highest Sustained Groundspeed (2+ minutes)
-- 
-- This query finds military aircraft that maintained high groundspeeds for at least 2 minutes.
-- Each aircraft (callsign) appears only once with their highest sustained performance.
-- Focuses specifically on military aircraft types with sustained speed over time.
--
-- Usage:
--   docker exec vatsim_postgres psql -U vatsim_user -d vatsim_data -f scripts/military_sustained_groundspeed.sql
--

-- Find military aircraft with sustained high groundspeeds for at least 2 minutes
WITH sustained_speeds AS (
    SELECT 
        f1.callsign,
        f1.aircraft_type,
        f1.departure,
        f1.arrival,
        f1.name as pilot_name,
        f1.groundspeed as sustained_speed_knots,
        f1.altitude as altitude_feet,
        f1.latitude,
        f1.longitude,
        f1.last_updated as start_time,
        f2.last_updated as end_time,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (f2.last_updated - f1.last_updated)) / 60.0 as duration_minutes
    FROM flights f1
    JOIN flights f2 ON f1.callsign = f2.callsign 
        AND f2.last_updated > f1.last_updated
        AND f2.last_updated <= f1.last_updated + INTERVAL '5 minutes'  -- Look ahead up to 5 minutes
    WHERE 
        -- Base conditions for f1
        f1.groundspeed IS NOT NULL 
        AND f1.groundspeed > 300  -- Higher threshold for military performance
        AND f1.groundspeed <= 2000  -- Allow for supersonic military aircraft
        AND f1.altitude > 1000  -- Must be airborne
        AND f1.last_updated >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month'  -- Last month only
        AND f1.arrival IS NOT NULL  -- Must have destination
        AND f1.arrival != ''  -- Destination cannot be empty
        
        -- Speed must be sustained (f2 speed close to f1 speed)
        AND f2.groundspeed IS NOT NULL
        AND f2.groundspeed >= f1.groundspeed * 0.9  -- Speed within 10% of initial speed
        AND f2.groundspeed <= f1.groundspeed * 1.1  -- Speed within 10% of initial speed
        
        -- Include ONLY military aircraft
        AND (
            -- Fighter jets and interceptors
            f1.aircraft_type IN (
                'F14', 'F15', 'F16', 'F18', 'F18S', 'F22', 'F35', 'F4', 'F5',
                'F111', 'F117', 'A4', 'A6', 'A7', 'B1', 'B2', 'SR71', 'U2', 'TR1',
                'MIG21', 'MIG23', 'MIG25', 'MIG29', 'MIG31',
                'SU27', 'SU30', 'SU33', 'SU35', 'SU57',
                'TYPH', 'RAF', 'GRIP', 'MIR2', 'MIR4', 'HAR', 'JAG',
                'TORN', 'VIGG', 'M2K', 'RAPH', 'EF2K', 'GR4', 'FGR4'
            )
            -- Or aircraft types that start with common military prefixes
            OR f1.aircraft_type LIKE 'F-%'
            OR f1.aircraft_type LIKE 'MIG%'
            OR f1.aircraft_type LIKE 'SU-%'
            OR f1.aircraft_type LIKE 'TU-%'
            OR f1.aircraft_type LIKE 'MIR%'
            OR f1.aircraft_type LIKE 'A-%'
            OR f1.aircraft_type LIKE 'B-%'
            OR f1.aircraft_type LIKE 'C-%'  -- Military C-130, C-17, etc.
            OR f1.aircraft_type LIKE 'E-%'  -- Military E-2, E-3, etc.
            OR f1.aircraft_type LIKE 'H-%'  -- Military helicopters
            OR f1.aircraft_type LIKE 'P-%'  -- Military patrol aircraft
            OR f1.aircraft_type LIKE 'T-%'  -- Military trainers
            OR f1.aircraft_type LIKE 'V-%'  -- Military V-22, etc.
            OR f1.aircraft_type LIKE 'X-%'  -- Experimental military aircraft
            OR f1.aircraft_type LIKE 'Y-%'  -- Military prototypes
            OR f1.aircraft_type LIKE 'Z-%'  -- Military drones/UAVs
            -- Additional military aircraft types
            OR f1.aircraft_type IN (
                'HERC', 'C130', 'C17', 'C5', 'C141',  -- Military transport
                'E2', 'E3', 'E4', 'E6', 'E8',          -- Military command/control
                'H60', 'H64', 'H47', 'H53', 'H1',     -- Military helicopters
                'P3', 'P8', 'P1',                       -- Military patrol
                'T38', 'T45', 'T6', 'T1',              -- Military trainers
                'V22', 'V280',                          -- Military tiltrotor
                'X35', 'X47', 'YF23', 'YF22'           -- Experimental/prototype
            )
        )
),
-- Get the best sustained performance for each callsign
best_sustained AS (
    SELECT 
        callsign,
        aircraft_type,
        departure,
        arrival,
        pilot_name,
        sustained_speed_knots,
        altitude_feet,
        start_time,
        end_time,
        duration_minutes,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY callsign ORDER BY sustained_speed_knots DESC, duration_minutes DESC) as rn
    FROM sustained_speeds
    WHERE duration_minutes >= 2.0  -- Must sustain speed for at least 2 minutes
)
SELECT 
    callsign,
    pilot_name,
    aircraft_type,
    departure,
    arrival,
    sustained_speed_knots,
    altitude_feet,
    duration_minutes,
    start_time,
    end_time
FROM best_sustained
WHERE rn = 1  -- Only the best sustained performance for each callsign
ORDER BY sustained_speed_knots DESC, duration_minutes DESC
LIMIT 10;

name: What was the fastest Milk Run Monday time (YMML-YSSY)?
sql:
WITH mel_syd AS (
  SELECT
    fs.id,
    fs.callsign,
    fs.name,
    fs.aircraft_type,
    fs.logon_time,
    fs.completion_time,
    (
      SELECT MIN(fo.entry_timestamp)
      FROM flight_sector_occupancy fo
      WHERE fo.callsign = fs.callsign
        AND fo.sector_name = 'MLA'
        AND fo.entry_timestamp BETWEEN fs.logon_time AND fs.completion_time
    ) AS mla_entry_time,
    (
      SELECT MAX(fo.exit_timestamp)
      FROM flight_sector_occupancy fo
      WHERE fo.callsign = fs.callsign
        AND fo.sector_name = 'SYA'
        AND fo.exit_timestamp BETWEEN fs.logon_time AND fs.completion_time
    ) AS sya_exit_time
  FROM flight_summaries fs
  WHERE fs.departure = 'YMML'
    AND fs.arrival = 'YSSY'
    AND EXTRACT(DOW FROM fs.completion_time) = 1
    AND fs.completion_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '6 months'
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (sya_exit_time - mla_entry_time)) / 60.0 AS mla_sya_minutes
  FROM mel_syd
  WHERE mla_entry_time IS NOT NULL
    AND sya_exit_time IS NOT NULL
    AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM mla_entry_time) >= 9  -- MLA entry after 0900 UTC
    AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM sya_exit_time) < 12   -- SYA exit before 1200 UTC
)
SELECT
  id,
  callsign,
  name,
  aircraft_type,
  logon_time,
  completion_time,
  mla_entry_time,
  sya_exit_time,
  ROUND(mla_sya_minutes, 1) AS mla_sya_minutes
FROM filtered
WHERE mla_sya_minutes >= 0
ORDER BY mla_sya_minutes ASC
LIMIT 10;

-- Longest Online FSS and CTR Controllers
-- 
-- This query finds which FSS (Flight Service Station) and CTR (Center) controllers
-- were online for the longest time, including total aircraft handled.
--
-- Usage:
--   docker exec vatsim_postgres psql -U vatsim_user -d vatsim_data -f scripts/longest_online_fss_ctr_controllers.sql
--

-- Find longest online FSS and CTR controllers
WITH fss_ctr_controllers AS (
    SELECT 
        callsign,
        name as controller_name,
        cid,
        rating,
        facility,
        server,
        session_start_time,
        session_end_time,
        session_duration_minutes,
        total_aircraft_handled,
        peak_aircraft_count,
        frequencies_used,
        aircraft_details
    FROM controller_summaries
    WHERE callsign LIKE '%FSS%'  -- Flight Service Station controllers
        OR callsign LIKE '%CTR%'  -- Center controllers
        AND session_duration_minutes > 0  -- Must have valid session duration
        AND session_start_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month'  -- Last month
),
ranked_controllers AS (
    SELECT 
        callsign,
        controller_name,
        cid,
        rating,
        facility,
        server,
        session_start_time,
        session_end_time,
        session_duration_minutes,
        total_aircraft_handled,
        peak_aircraft_count,
        frequencies_used,
        aircraft_details,
        -- Rank by session duration (longest first)
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY session_duration_minutes DESC) as duration_rank,
        -- Rank by aircraft handled (most first)
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_aircraft_handled DESC) as aircraft_rank
    FROM fss_ctr_controllers
    WHERE session_duration_minutes > 0  -- Additional safety check
)
SELECT 
    duration_rank,
    callsign,
    controller_name,
    cid,
    rating,
    facility,
    server,
    session_start_time,
    session_end_time,
    session_duration_minutes,
    total_aircraft_handled,
    peak_aircraft_count,
    -- Calculate average aircraft per hour
    ROUND(total_aircraft_handled::numeric / NULLIF(session_duration_minutes / 60, 0), 1) as avg_aircraft_per_hour,
    -- Show which frequencies were used
    frequencies_used,
    -- Show aircraft interaction details
    aircraft_details
FROM ranked_controllers
ORDER BY session_duration_minutes DESC
LIMIT 20;

-- ============================================================================
-- SUMMARY STATISTICS FOR FSS AND CTR CONTROLLERS
-- ============================================================================
-- This section provides summary statistics for all FSS and CTR controllers

WITH fss_ctr_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        session_duration_minutes,
        total_aircraft_handled,
        peak_aircraft_count,
        -- Categorize by controller type
        CASE 
            WHEN callsign LIKE '%FSS%' THEN 'FSS'
            WHEN callsign LIKE '%CTR%' THEN 'CTR'
            ELSE 'OTHER'
        END as controller_type
    FROM controller_summaries
    WHERE (callsign LIKE '%FSS%' OR callsign LIKE '%CTR%')
        AND session_duration_minutes > 0
        AND session_start_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month'
)
SELECT 
    controller_type,
    COUNT(*) as total_sessions,
    ROUND(AVG(session_duration_minutes), 1) as avg_session_duration_minutes,
    MIN(session_duration_minutes) as shortest_session_minutes,
    MAX(session_duration_minutes) as longest_session_minutes,
    ROUND(STDDEV(session_duration_minutes), 1) as std_dev_minutes,
    ROUND(AVG(total_aircraft_handled), 1) as avg_aircraft_handled,
    MIN(total_aircraft_handled) as min_aircraft_handled,
    MAX(total_aircraft_handled) as max_aircraft_handled,
    ROUND(AVG(peak_aircraft_count), 1) as avg_peak_aircraft,
    -- Calculate efficiency (aircraft per hour)
    ROUND(AVG(total_aircraft_handled::numeric / NULLIF(session_duration_minutes / 60, 0)), 1) as avg_efficiency_aircraft_per_hour
FROM fss_ctr_stats
GROUP BY controller_type
ORDER BY avg_session_duration_minutes DESC;

-- Count of flights and ATC active by hour on weekdays for last 90 days
-- Shows both metrics on same timeline for comparison

WITH flight_hours AS (
    SELECT 
        f.callsign,
        f.logon_time,
        f.completion_time,
        generate_series(
            EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.logon_time),
            CASE 
                WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.completion_time) >= EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.logon_time) 
                THEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.completion_time)
                ELSE EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.completion_time) + 24  -- Handle overnight flights
            END
        ) % 24 as active_hour  -- Wrap back to 0-23 range
    FROM flight_summaries f
    WHERE f.completion_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
        AND f.total_enroute_time_minutes > 0
        AND EXTRACT(DOW FROM f.logon_time) IN (0, 1, 6)  -- Sun, Mon, Sat (where your data is)
        AND f.logon_time IS NOT NULL
        AND f.completion_time IS NOT NULL
),
atc_hours AS (
    SELECT 
        cs.callsign,
        cs.session_start_time,
        cs.session_end_time,
        generate_series(
            EXTRACT(HOUR FROM cs.session_start_time),
            CASE 
                WHEN cs.session_end_time IS NULL THEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM NOW())
                WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM cs.session_end_time) >= EXTRACT(HOUR FROM cs.session_start_time)
                THEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM cs.session_end_time)
                ELSE EXTRACT(HOUR FROM cs.session_end_time) + 24  -- Handle overnight sessions
            END
        ) % 24 as active_hour  -- Wrap back to 0-23 range
    FROM controller_summaries cs
    WHERE (cs.session_start_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
        OR cs.session_end_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days')
        AND cs.session_duration_minutes >= 20
        AND EXTRACT(DOW FROM cs.session_start_time) IN (0, 1, 6)  -- Sun, Mon, Sat (where your data is)
        AND cs.session_start_time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(fh.active_hour, ah.active_hour) as hour,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fh.callsign) as active_flights,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ah.callsign) as active_atc
FROM flight_hours fh
FULL OUTER JOIN atc_hours ah ON fh.active_hour = ah.active_hour
GROUP BY COALESCE(fh.active_hour, ah.active_hour)
ORDER BY hour;

WITH params AS (
  SELECT (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' - INTERVAL '8 hours') AS cutoff
),
base AS (
  SELECT callsign, cid, departure, arrival,
         COALESCE(logon_time, last_updated) AS logon_time,
         last_updated, deptime, route
  FROM flights
  WHERE last_updated < (SELECT cutoff FROM params)
    AND logon_time IS NOT NULL
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT b.*, 
         LAG(last_updated) OVER (
           PARTITION BY callsign, cid, departure, arrival
           ORDER BY GREATEST(logon_time, last_updated), last_updated
         ) AS prev_last_updated
  FROM base b
),
segmented AS (
  SELECT *,
         CASE
           WHEN prev_last_updated IS NULL THEN 1
           WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (logon_time - prev_last_updated)) / 60.0 > 120 THEN 1
           ELSE 0
         END AS is_new_seg
  FROM ordered
),
labeled AS (
  SELECT *,
         SUM(is_new_seg) OVER (
           PARTITION BY callsign, cid, departure, arrival
           ORDER BY GREATEST(logon_time, last_updated), last_updated
           ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
         ) AS segment_id
  FROM segmented
),
sessions AS (
  SELECT
    callsign, cid, departure, arrival,
    MIN(logon_time) AS session_start,
    MAX(last_updated) AS session_end
  FROM labeled
  GROUP BY callsign, cid, departure, arrival, segment_id
),
awaiting AS (
  SELECT s.*
  FROM sessions s
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM flight_summaries fs
    WHERE fs.callsign   = s.callsign
      AND fs.cid        IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.cid
      AND fs.departure  IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.departure
      AND fs.arrival    IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.arrival
      AND fs.logon_time IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.session_start
  )
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS awaiting_flight_summaries
FROM awaiting;

name: Flow - when a flight is first associated with a controller record
sql:
-- Controller end→processed flow with cap to avoid repair/backfill distortion
-- Window: last 24h; Grace: ignore last 1h; Cap: only include rows processed within 120 min of end

WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' - INTERVAL '24 hours') AS lookback,
    (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' - INTERVAL '1 hour')  AS grace_cutoff,
    INTERVAL '120 minutes'                           AS max_real_time_lag
),
ended AS (
  SELECT cs.id, cs.session_end_time, cs.updated_at
  FROM controller_summaries cs
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE cs.session_end_time IS NOT NULL
    AND cs.session_end_time BETWEEN p.lookback AND p.grace_cutoff
),
eligible AS (
  -- Keep only rows processed within the real-time cap after end
  SELECT e.*
  FROM ended e
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE e.updated_at >= e.session_end_time
    AND e.updated_at <= e.session_end_time + p.max_real_time_lag
),
lags AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (updated_at - session_end_time))/60.0 AS minutes_after_end
  FROM eligible
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ended)    AS total_ended,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eligible) AS eligible_rows
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY minutes_after_end)::numeric, 2) FROM lags), 0) AS p50_minutes,
  COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY minutes_after_end)::numeric, 2) FROM lags), 0) AS p90_minutes,
  COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY minutes_after_end)::numeric, 2) FROM lags), 0) AS p95_minutes,
  c.total_ended,
  c.eligible_rows,
  CASE WHEN c.total_ended > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * c.eligible_rows::numeric / c.total_ended, 2) ELSE 0 END AS coverage_pct
FROM counts c;

    AND fs.controller_callsigns <> '{}'::jsonb

  WHERE cs.enrichment_status = 'completed'
)

FROM flight_ctrl fc
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM controller_hits ch
  WHERE ch.callsign = fc.controller_callsign
    AND ch.session_start_time <= fc.completion_time
    AND ch.session_end_time >= fc.logon_time

sql:
-- corrected_controller_slots_aligned.sql
-- Align controller-generated slots to the canonical 5-minute grid and
-- convert frequencies robustly. This ensures controller_slots.time_slot
-- matches time_slots.time_slot so joins succeed.

WITH recent_monday AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM CURRENT_DATE) = 1 THEN CURRENT_DATE
            ELSE CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' * (EXTRACT(DOW FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1)
        END AS monday_date
),
time_slots AS (
    SELECT
        monday_date + INTERVAL '8 hours' + (generate_series(0, 47) * INTERVAL '5 minutes') AS time_slot
    FROM recent_monday
),
controller_slots AS (
    SELECT
        cs.callsign,
        CASE
            WHEN rf.raw_freq = '' THEN NULL
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN rf.raw_freq) > 0 THEN (round(rf.raw_freq::numeric, 3) * 1000000)::bigint
            ELSE rf.raw_freq::bigint
        END AS frequency,
        generate_series(
            -- Align session start to nearest 5-minute grid used by time_slots
            to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM GREATEST(cs.session_start_time, rm.monday_date + INTERVAL '8 hours'))/300)*300)::timestamptz,
            LEAST(COALESCE(cs.session_end_time, rm.monday_date + INTERVAL '12 hours'), rm.monday_date + INTERVAL '12 hours'),
            INTERVAL '5 minutes'
        ) AS time_slot
    FROM controller_summaries cs
    CROSS JOIN recent_monday rm
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT regexp_replace(jsonb_array_elements_text(cs.frequencies_used), '[^0-9\.]', '', 'g') AS raw_freq
    ) rf
    WHERE cs.frequencies_used IS NOT NULL
      AND cs.session_start_time < rm.monday_date + INTERVAL '12 hours'
      AND (cs.session_end_time IS NULL OR cs.session_end_time > rm.monday_date + INTERVAL '8 hours')
),
flight_counts AS (
    SELECT
        ts.time_slot,
        ft.frequency,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ft.callsign) AS unique_callsigns
    FROM transceivers ft
    JOIN time_slots ts
      ON ft.timestamp >= ts.time_slot - INTERVAL '3 minutes'
     AND ft.timestamp <  ts.time_slot + INTERVAL '3 minutes'
    WHERE ft.entity_type = 'flight'
      AND ft.frequency BETWEEN 118000000 AND 137000000
      AND ft.frequency NOT IN (120500000, 121700000, 126500000)
      AND NOT (ft.frequency BETWEEN 121500000 AND 121500999)
    GROUP BY
        ft.frequency,
        ts.time_slot
)

SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cs.time_slot, cs.callsign) AS id,
    cs.time_slot      AS time,
    cs.callsign       AS series,
    COALESCE(fc.unique_callsigns, 0) AS value
FROM controller_slots cs
LEFT JOIN flight_counts fc
  ON fc.frequency BETWEEN cs.frequency - 5000 AND cs.frequency + 5000
 AND cs.time_slot = fc.time_slot
WHERE cs.frequency BETWEEN 118000000 AND 137000000
  AND cs.frequency NOT IN (120500000, 121700000, 126500000)
  AND NOT (cs.frequency BETWEEN 121500000 AND 121500999)
  AND cs.callsign NOT ILIKE '%DEL%'

-- Australia % of Total Airborne Time for YMML<->YSSY (Mondays 08:00-12:00 UTC, grouped by week)
WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('week', completion_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS week_start_utc,
        name,
        time_online_minutes,
        departure,
        arrival
    FROM flight_summaries
    WHERE name IS NOT NULL
        AND LENGTH(name) >= 4
        AND time_online_minutes IS NOT NULL
        AND time_online_minutes > 0
        -- only Mondays in UTC
        AND date_part('dow', completion_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') = 1
        AND (completion_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::time >= time '08:00'
        AND (completion_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::time <  time '12:00'
        -- only flights between YMML and YSSY (either direction)
        AND (
            (departure = 'YMML' AND arrival = 'YSSY')
            OR (departure = 'YSSY' AND arrival = 'YMML')
        )
)
SELECT
    week_start_utc,
    SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(name, LENGTH(name) - 3, 1) = 'Y' THEN time_online_minutes ELSE 0 END) AS australia_minutes,
    SUM(time_online_minutes) AS total_minutes,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(time_online_minutes) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(name, LENGTH(name) - 3, 1) = 'Y' THEN time_online_minutes ELSE 0 END) / SUM(time_online_minutes), 2)
    END AS australia_percentage
FROM filtered
GROUP BY week_start_utc
ORDER BY week_start_utc DESC;

SELECT 
    airport,
    SUM(departures) as departures,
    SUM(arrivals) as arrivals,
    SUM(departures + arrivals) as total_movements
FROM (
    SELECT 
        departure as airport,
        COUNT(*) as departures,
        0 as arrivals
    FROM flight_summaries 
    WHERE departure IS NOT NULL 
        AND departure != ''
        AND departure LIKE 'Y%'
        AND completion_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month'
    GROUP BY departure
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        arrival as airport,
        0 as departures,
        COUNT(*) as arrivals
    FROM flight_summaries 
    WHERE arrival IS NOT NULL 
        AND arrival != ''
        AND arrival LIKE 'Y%'
        AND completion_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month'
    GROUP BY arrival
) movements
GROUP BY airport
HAVING SUM(departures + arrivals) > 0
ORDER BY SUM(departures + arrivals) ASC
LIMIT 20;

WITH weekly_periods AS (
  SELECT 
    date_trunc('week', generate_series(
      (SELECT MIN(session_start_time) FROM controller_summaries),
      (SELECT MAX(session_start_time) FROM controller_summaries),
      '1 week'::interval
    )) AS week_start,
    date_trunc('week', generate_series(
      (SELECT MIN(session_start_time) FROM controller_summaries),
      (SELECT MAX(session_start_time) FROM controller_summaries),
      '1 week'::interval
    )) + '1 week'::interval AS week_end
),
weekly_controller_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    wp.week_start,
    wp.week_end,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cid) AS distinct_controllers_30day
  FROM weekly_periods wp
  LEFT JOIN controller_summaries cs ON cs.session_start_time >= (wp.week_end - '30 days'::interval) 
                                    AND cs.session_start_time < wp.week_end
  WHERE cs.session_duration_minutes > 60
  GROUP BY wp.week_start, wp.week_end
  ORDER BY wp.week_start
)
SELECT 
  week_start AS date,
  distinct_controllers_30day AS controllers
FROM weekly_controller_counts
WHERE distinct_controllers_30day > 0
ORDER BY week_start;

-- SYDNEY AIRPORT DEPARTURES BOARD FOR METABASE
-- =============================================
-- This query is optimized for Metabase display
-- Shows current flight status, aircraft types, destinations, and summary statistics

WITH latest_flights AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (callsign)
        callsign,
        name,
        departure,
        arrival,
        aircraft_type,
        groundspeed,
        altitude,
        last_updated,
        deptime,
        flight_rules,
        CASE 
            WHEN groundspeed > 100 THEN 'DEPARTED'
            WHEN groundspeed > 0 AND groundspeed <= 100 THEN 'TAXIING'
            WHEN groundspeed = 0 AND altitude < 100 THEN 'AT GATE'
            WHEN groundspeed = 0 AND altitude >= 100 THEN 'BOARDING'
            ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
        END as status,
        CASE 
            WHEN groundspeed > 100 THEN 'D'
            WHEN groundspeed > 0 AND groundspeed <= 100 THEN 'T'
            WHEN groundspeed = 0 AND altitude < 100 THEN 'G'
            WHEN groundspeed = 0 AND altitude >= 100 THEN 'B'
            ELSE '?'
        END as status_icon
    FROM flights 
    WHERE departure = 'YSSY' 
        AND DATE(last_updated) = CURRENT_DATE
        AND last_updated >= '2025-09-21 09:00:00+00'
    ORDER BY callsign, last_updated DESC
),
board_data AS (
    SELECT 
        callsign,
        arrival,
        COALESCE(aircraft_type, 'N/A') as aircraft_type,
        status_icon || ' ' || status as status_display,
        COALESCE(deptime, 'N/A') as scheduled_departure,
        groundspeed,
        altitude,
        COALESCE(flight_rules, 'N/A') as flight_rules,
        last_updated,
        'A' || LPAD((ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY callsign))::TEXT, 2, '0') as gate,
        CASE 
            WHEN groundspeed > 100 THEN 'DEPARTED'
            WHEN groundspeed > 0 AND groundspeed <= 100 THEN 'TAXIING'
            WHEN groundspeed = 0 AND altitude < 100 THEN 'AT GATE'
            WHEN groundspeed = 0 AND altitude >= 100 THEN 'BOARDING'
            ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
        END as status_clean
    FROM latest_flights
    ORDER BY 
        CASE 
            WHEN groundspeed > 100 THEN 4
            WHEN groundspeed > 0 AND groundspeed <= 100 THEN 3
            WHEN groundspeed = 0 AND altitude >= 100 THEN 2
            WHEN groundspeed = 0 AND altitude < 100 THEN 1
            ELSE 5
        END,
        last_updated DESC
    LIMIT 25
)
SELECT 
    callsign as "Flight",
    arrival as "Destination",
    gate as "Gate",
    status_clean as "Status",
    scheduled_departure as "Scheduled",
    'ON TIME' as "Delay",
    groundspeed as "Speed (kts)",
    altitude as "Altitude (ft)",
    flight_rules as "Rules",
    aircraft_type as "Aircraft",
    last_updated as "Last Update"
FROM board_data
ORDER BY 
    CASE status_clean
        WHEN 'AT GATE' THEN 1
        WHEN 'BOARDING' THEN 2
        WHEN 'TAXIING' THEN 3
        WHEN 'DEPARTED' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
    END,
    last_updated DESC;
